Prepare right axis labels and get width

right_axis_label_width.Rd

Mirror of left_axis_label_width: same measurement at the same point size, same title wrapping to the plot height, but it sets the right margin instead of the left. Must run after get_top_margin_and_title, which resets mar[4].

Usage

right_axis_label_width(
  config,
  y_axis,
  language = "si",
  edge_pad = 0.35,
  label_ps = ps_legend()
)

Arguments

config

config for the right axis, from config_for_axis

y_axis

the right-hand scale from pair_y_scales

language

language, options en and si, default si

edge_pad

for padding right margin

label_ps

controls label font size

Value

list of axis title, axis labels, positions and number of lines
